pins.definition: Feeling fear or worry because of something.
Feeling or showing fear or worry; easily frightened.

situation: A woman alone in her dark living room has just heard a loud, unexplained crash against her back door.
subject: the sudden physical expression of fear
brief: A woman stands frozen in the center of a dimly lit room, her eyes wide and pupils dilated, hands pressed flat against her mouth in shock. Sharp ink hatching radiates outward from behind her head to capture the sudden jolt of terror, while the dark doorway looms behind her.
